tip: Never share your OTP or bank details with anyone, even if they claim to be from your bank.
Avoid clicking on links in SMS from unknown numbers.
Legitimate companies will never ask for sensitive info via SMS.
If a message sounds too urgent or threatening, pause and verify it first.
Always check the sender's number and look for typos or suspicious formatting in SMS.
Never reply to a smishing message – it confirms your number is active.
Use your bank's official app or website rather than clicking on message links.
Block and report numbers that send fraudulent messages.
Enable spam detection on your device or install an SMS filtering app.
Monitor your credit card and bank statements regularly for unauthorized charges.
Consider using two-factor authentication for all sensitive apps and accounts.
Educate your family members about common scam tactics and how to avoid them.
